hypothesis: Determine whether each independently admitted OrthoBench point-gate pass transfers unchanged to complete corrected QfO and supplementary Three Kingdoms. Small development gains and intervals spanning zero are not proof of transfer.
arm_selection: Exactly none plus every passing label from the independently admitted pilot in its original order. Verify the full raw readback, original gates, terminal producer/readback jobs and compact admission, not merely a hand-picked best score. The failed species_henikoff_cluster branch remains stopped with unrun endpoints explicitly NA.
control: Rebuild the none graph/profile/refinement/candidate pass from each dataset's authenticated canonical initial HMM-hit checkpoint, then run ordinary inferred-species-tree/native reconciliation. Require exact original candidate partition, membership constraints, native products and rooted species tree, plus independently reproduced canonical scores before accepting either weighted arm.
inference: Use the exact pilot620bfdf9 scientific modules, original unchanged CPU libraries, runtime and settings. The standalone execution driver may add orchestration/provenance only and must reject imports from a different scientific checkout. Each weighted arm changes only profile_sequence_weighting. BLOSUM62, fixed min4/cap100 initial hits, CPM0.1/seed4, one profile pass, default refinement, satellite_v2 constraints and inferred min_variance/species_overlap/positive_paralogy/legacy reconciliation remain unchanged. No global alignment guard, local rescue, HMMER validation or new annotation-dependent rule is combined into this follow-up.
caching: Reuse only exact-compatible baseline raw gene-tree/species-tree caches through the existing native replay harness. Always re-root/reconcile as the native pipeline requires; changed species trees remain possible for weighted arms. Record cache hits/remaps and shared-host incremental stage costs, not isolated fresh full-pipeline runtime.
scoring: For QfO, assess native inferred ortholog pairs using the existing corrected six-challenge workflow and unchanged reference snapshot. Require complete gene/species ownership, native pair/confidence/count validation and zero conversion/mapping loss. Use unique short scoring/participant namespaces per dataset/arm and validate Darwin work-path length before submission; preserve every previous namespace.

For the exact reproduced QfO none control, the already independently verified canonical recovery assessment may be reused only after byte-exact native-product equivalence and fresh raw assessment/readback checks. Label this scoring reuse; do not call it a fresh stochastic FAS replicate or include its absent computation as new runtime.

For each weighted QfO arm, run and independently validate VGNC, SwissTrees and supporting TreeFam-A F1/precision/recall plus EC/GO/FAS similarity means and assessed populations. FAS's existing unseeded assessment remains a limitation. Higher conditional means from changed relation populations are not automatically improved orthology accuracy.

For Three Kingdoms, score each complete native root partition against the same retained BUSCO-derived reference with repeated independent readback. Preserve its limited/supplementary interpretation rather than treating all cross-kingdom genes or absent BUSCO families as adjudicated truth.
failure_and_stopping: A failed control blocks active arms for that dataset. Failure of one weighted arm does not suppress the other declared arm or silently trigger parameter changes. Keep failed/inactive/unrun stages explicit, preserve fresh execution/scoring namespaces and require current scheduler/process evidence before recovery. Do not retune weighting, thresholds, budgets or reconciliation using follow-up labels.
reporting: Report all eight endpoint slots by combining the admitted OrthoBench cells with newly admitted follow-up cells, including precision/recall, coverage, functional populations, resources, uncertainty where defensible and all failures/NA. Compare against the frozen canonical baseline, OrthoFinder3.1.5 full and retained contextual tools. Do not average heterogeneous endpoints into an invented overall score, claim all-metric superiority from a pilot gain, or change the original advancement rule after observing these results. Default recommendations remain governed by the parent evidence/generalizability criteria.

resources.execution_order: Sequential dataset jobs after existing queued scientific jobs; within each dataset none then each eligible weighting arm in original order.

git: Commit and push this protocol and the compact independently admitted pilot evidence before implementing/executing the follow-up. Then push focused tested driver, immutable plans/submission records, readbacks, complete comparison table and decisions. Preserve unrelated user changes and all existing source trees/jobs.
